scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @trustiq/core && npm run build -w @trustiq/ai && npm run build -w @trustiq/server
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @trustiq/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @trustiq/core && npm run test -w @trustiq/ai && npm run test -w @trustiq/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @trustiq/core && npm run typecheck -w @trustiq/ai && npm run typecheck -w @trustiq/server
